newsitem.title: ISRAEL: King Hussein not going to Israel on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: King Hussein not going to Israel on Wednesday.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein will not meet Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Jerusalem on Wednesday on a peace-saving mission as previously announced, Israel said on Tuesday.
A statement by Netanyahu's office offered no explanation for why the monarch would instead send his brother, Crown Prince Hassan, and Jordan's Prime Minister Abdul-Salam al-Majali.
In Amman, the royal palace confirmed the high-level visit.

An official in Crown Prince Hassan's office, who declined to be identified, said: "The objective would be to overcome obstacles in the peace process and restarting talks between the Israelis and Palestinians."

Jordan and Egypt -- Arab states at peace with Israel -- have been trying to mediate an end to a crisis in Israeli-PLO peacemaking which deepened with a suicide attack that killed 15 people, including two bombers, in Jerusalem last week.
Netanyahu's office, which on Monday night announced the pending visit by the monarch, said on Tuesday the Israeli leader would instead meet King Hussein in Jordan next week.
The Jordanian official called the report about the king's planned visit "speculation". The official said: "The only decision taken is that His Majesty would send a high-level delegation."
